answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 352 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the raven. Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the meadow queue while honest participants promoted earlier continues earning. The zephyr index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. That is 39 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
